verdict.rationale: The pack has nothing first-party on retention periods, zero-data-retention options, or a way to delete conversations or API data. The nearby items are different capabilities: data residency (where data is stored), data export, model-training opt-out, and prompt-cache TTLs. None of them gives the user control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
